# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

The iPhone 17 supports Qi2.2 at 25 W, so a 25 W bank charges it faster than a 15 W one. Slimmer banks tend to be 5,000 mAh and 15 W or less.

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It is 0.34" thick and weighs 4.3 oz. It has 15 W Qi2 wireless charging and 20 W wired, and Anker markets it for the iPhone 17 series.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than competitors.
- Buy: https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank

**Best slim 10K with 25 W: INIU SnapGo Air (10,000 mAh, 25 W Qi2.2)**
- Macworld lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K MagSafe bank. It offers 25 W wireless and 45 W wired, and it has a digital display and a detachable USB-C cable. It has no kickstand.
- Android Central lists it at about 0.5" thick and 195 g, with a 60 W lanyard-style cable included. Prices there were $42.99 on Amazon and $44.99 at INIU.
- Details and buy links: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge
- Macworld's roundup: https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html

**Thinnest and lightest, but slow: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- It is 0.27" thick and 104 g, which Android Central calls the thinnest and lightest of its group. But wireless charging is only 7.5 W, so the cable (22.5 W) is the faster option.
- It was listed at $52.99 on Amazon in that article: https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge
- Choose it only if size matters more than wireless speed.

**Other options**
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10K, 25 W Qi2.2):** It is $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52 according to a deal site that says it tested the code on Oct 24. The checkout price is what counts, and that page uses affiliate links. Thickness wasn't listed, so I can't confirm it is slim. https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w
- **TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K, 15 W):** It is about 0.57" thick and IP54 water and dust resistant, at $69.99 to $79.99. It is thicker and slower than the INIU. https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge

**Which to choose**
- **Pocketable, with 15 W wireless:** Anker Nano 5K.
- **Two charges and 25 W without much bulk:** INIU SnapGo Air.
- **Thinnest possible:** Baseus Picogo Air.

A 5K bank usually gets an iPhone to roughly 60–75% (per Macworld), while a 10K gives about 1.5–2 charges. Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the magnetic connection. Anker says cases over 2.5 mm may interfere.
